The '''''Scorching Pulsar''''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was a rival of the ''[[Dreaded Shyrack]]''. The two destroyed each other in a shootout during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], prompting scavengers to raid the vessels for their treasure.
